author: Bellular News
description:
Investors wanted ads inside games. EA has now launched the platform to make that real. Most players don’t keep spending after buying the game, so publishers are looking at another customer entirely: the brands who want access to you. That can be harmless when it fits the world. It can also get grim very quickly.

Join us at http://bellular.games for early access content, 20 editions of 'Loading Screen' a month and to support our team!
